posts.title: Would you trust AI to book your estimates?
posts.text: I've been testing AI phone answering for my brother's landscaping company. Getting it to answer questions is one thing, but letting it put appointments on the calendar is another. There are jobs we don't take, and the last thing I want is an estimate booked for something we don't even do. Would you let AI book estimates, or would you rather have it take the information and call the customer back?
posts.author: ken_3584

posts.title: Do you guys ask for Google reviews?
posts.text: When you finish a job, do you ask the customer for a Google review, or just let them come in on their own? Curious how most of you handle it.

posts.title: Do you guys charge for inspections before giving an estimate?
posts.text: Hey guys, Curious how everyone handles inspections before giving a quote. For smaller jobs, a quick walkthrough is usually enough. But when a homeowner complains about cold rooms, moisture, or possible insulation problems, it can take a lot more time to figure out what's actually going on.
